history.new: Published - Baird-Smith, Epstein, Flint, Miller, The Zeckendorf Game (PROMS 297, 2020; arXiv:1809.04881) Figs 3-4 list the longest games for n <= 49 (identical to our n <= 40); Cusenza et al., Fibonacci Quart. 60 (2022) prove the greedy strategy optimal and give a closed form only for n = F_k - 1; Cheigh et al. (PROMS 2025) state the general closed form is open. The sequence is not yet in the OEIS (possible documentation contribution).
history.old: The longest Zeckendorf game is studied by Cusenza et al. and the Williams SMALL group; the value sequence was not found in the OEIS (2026-10-18). No closed form known to us.
